config_label: tp=2 x CFG-parallel (uncond/cond on separate core pairs); tp=4, bf16, TP-sharded transformer + attention_cte self-attn, guidance=1.0 (batch-1 NEFF)
notes: per-step = 779.7 ms/DiT-step (median 779.3, p90 780.9, n=19) — measured the SAME way as H100: inter-step deltas of a real 20-step generate (wrapping NeuronLTX2Application.forward_dit, synced, step 0 excluded), NOT the old isolated synthetic-input timer. 20 DiT calls timed; warm generate 52s; output finite=True.
Default registry shape 512x768x121 also compiles; 480x704x49 used here as the representative fast shape. CFG (guidance>1) needs a batch-2 NEFF.
compile-only run: e2e/per-step come from cold_warm_e2e / step_realloop
e2e_cold = 1077 s — TRUE cold start (OS page cache dropped before the run), so the weight load is a real cold disk read.

e2e_warm = 510 s (n=1; reported after 2 discarded cache-warming run(s) so the OS page cache is warm). The difflet CLI reloads weights every process, so 'warm' = warm disk cache -> faster load, not a resident model; cf. e2e cold and the load/compute breakdown.
resident generate = 52.4 s (generate 3 of 3 in one process, model loaded once; walls [77.5, 52.7, 52.4]) -- the serving steady state; per-step above is from the last generate.
